name: Spinach Salad with Salmon, Couscous, Apples, Olives, Walnuts & Feta (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl, then stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
red wine vinegar
¾ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups chicken or vegetable broth
¾ cup whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat salmon dry with paper towels and cut into 3 portions. Season the top side with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb salmon fillet
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add salmon, skin-side down, and cook, flipping once, until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch fresh dill
1 Gala apple
1 medium carrot
1 (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
red wine vinegar
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter and core apple. Cut half of the apple into wedges and place on a plate for the kids. Thinly slice remaining apple and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the plate with the apple.
Add a handful of spinach leaves to the plate and set aside. Add remaining spinach to the bowl.
Halve olives. Roughly chop walnuts. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
¼ cup walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Set aside a ½-cup couscous, then add remaining couscous and pickled onions to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Break one portion of salmon into bite-sized pieces for the kid plates, discarding skin.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide reserved couscous, apple, carrot, spinach, and flaked salmon between plates. Serve with honey mustard for dipping. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide salad between plates, then top with feta and remaining salmon fillets. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup honey mustard dressing
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
